summary: The FCC Secretary discusses the concerns of the Safer Buildings Coalition regarding screen-time limits and parental-empowerment provisions in the Notice of Proposed Rulemaking. The coalition highlights the potential impact of screen-time limits on educational outcomes and the importance of emergency communication during school events. The comment supports maintaining standardization and state signaling for applications managed by schools and government agencies to manage student devices while preserving emergency connectivity. The comment opposes sunsetting the E-Rate program, citing statutory authority and legal implications. Broad opposition to sunsetting E-Rate programs, citing cost implications for schools and libraries. Proposes a School Mode solution to address phone distraction in schools while preserving emergency communication capability. Brief
